journey.name: Lift: change a program day and keep it
journey.description: Follow Goblet squat and row, change day 1 in the session (a heavier bell, a set changed after logging, the rows skipped), finish, and keep the change in a copy of the program, which is then followed from day 2 with the bell planned. Run on a fresh install (adb shell pm clear dev.justinsmith.interval).

actions.action: Tap the "Lift" tab, then "Follow a program"
Tap "Goblet squat and row", then "Follow this program"
Tap "Start day 1"
Verify that the session shows "Up next · 1 of 9 sets", "Goblet squat", "16 kg × 10", "Change", "Skip" and "Today's plan", with "Log set" at the bottom
Tap "Change" on the Up next card
Verify that a sheet shows an exercise card "Goblet squat" with "Change", "Bell" chips with "Last time" selected, "How it runs", "Sets" at "3" and "Reps" at "10"
Tap "24", then "Done"
Verify that Up next reads "24 kg × 10"
Tap "Log set"
Verify that "Up next · 2 of 9 sets" is shown and the session lists "Goblet squat" with a set "24 kg × 10", "Moved" at "240 kg"
Tap the set "24 kg × 10"
Verify that a sheet shows "Goblet squat" without "Change", no "An EMOM", and "Save set"
Tap "+" beside the reps once, then "Save set"
Verify that the set reads "24 kg × 11" and "Moved" reads "264 kg"
Tap "Today's plan"
Verify that the sheet lists "Goblet squat" "3 × 10 · 24 kg" "1 of 3 done" with "Changed", and "Row" "3 × 10 a side" "0 of 6 done"
Tap "Row"
Tap "Skip this block"
Verify that Up next reads "Goblet squat" and "2 of 3 sets"
Tap "Finish"
Scroll down the summary
Verify that "Keep today's changes?" shows "Goblet squat" with "3 × 10 → 3 × 10 · 24 kg", "This day" and "Every day", and "Save as Goblet squat and row (yours)"
Tap "Every day", then "Save as Goblet squat and row (yours)"
Verify that "Saved as Goblet squat and row (yours). You follow it from day 2." is shown
Tap "Done"
Verify that Lift shows "Day 2 of 8 · week 1", "Goblet squat and row (yours)", "Goblet squat" "3 × 10" with "24 kg", and "Start day 2"
